translations.source: Lake Premix is a leading ready-mix concrete company in Dar es Salaam and a subsidiary of Lake Group. Established in 2010 under Tanzanian company laws, the company has built its position through the supply of ready-mix concrete and participation in prestigious construction projects.
translations.translation: Lake Premix ni kampuni inayoongoza ya zege lililochanganywa tayari jijini Dar es Salaam na ni kampuni tanzu ya Lake Group. Ilianzishwa mwaka 2010 chini ya sheria za kampuni za Tanzania, kampuni imejenga nafasi yake kupitia usambazaji wa zege lililochanganywa tayari na kushiriki katika miradi ya ujenzi ya hadhi ya juu.
